title: Model Checkpoint Conversion
summary: This module provides utilities and scripts to convert pre-trained model checkpoints from various original frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, Fairseq, native PyTorch, Flax) into the Hugging Face Transformers PyTorch format. It ensures compatibility and enables seamless integration with the Hugging Face ecosystem.

nodes.label: Original Model Checkpoint
nodes.title: Source Model Weights
nodes.description: Contains pre-trained weights from various frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, Fairseq, native PyTorch, Flax, Haiku).

nodes.label: Extract Conversion Rules
nodes.title: Weight Conversion Logic
nodes.description: Identifies and retrieves specific weight mapping and transformation rules based on the model type or class name.

nodes.label: Define HF Configuration
nodes.title: Hugging Face Config
nodes.description: Generates or loads the appropriate Hugging Face model and processor configuration objects.

nodes.label: Load Original Weights
nodes.title: Load Source Weights
nodes.description: Loads the raw parameter state dictionary from the original model checkpoint file.

nodes.label: Transform & Rename Weights
nodes.title: Map to HF Format
nodes.description: Applies renaming, reshaping, and other transformations to align original weights with Hugging Face conventions.

nodes.label: Instantiate HF Model
nodes.title: Create HF Model
nodes.description: Initializes an empty Hugging Face model instance using the prepared configuration.

nodes.label: Instantiate HF Processor
nodes.title: Create HF Processor

nodes.label: Load Weights into HF Model

nodes.title: Validate Conversion
nodes.description: Compares the outputs (e.g., logits, hidden states) of the original and converted models to ensure numerical fidelity.
